title: egress-audit adapter
description: The product adapter is an ES module whose default export has these members. Every hook is async, receives a context {baseUrl, mode, env, fetch, log, headers} and runs inside the sealed audit network (in the driver container), so it reaches the product by its compose service name. Hooks that do not apply to a product may be omitted.

login.description: Signs in as the seeded admin and answers the headers later hooks send.

createFixtures.description: Creates what a user would create (a tenant, an organization, a project, a Work...). What it answers (ids and slugs, never a token) reaches the browser leg's hooks as ctx.fixtures.

uiLogin.description: Browser leg: async uiLogin(page, ctx) signs in through the product's real sign-in page with the Playwright page (ctx: {baseUrl, webUrl, routing, routeUrl(route), apiUrl, mode, env, fixtures, fetch, log}; baseUrl + a route is the route's URL: web_url, or web_url/# with hash routing). It runs in the browser container, in the browser's sniffed namespace.

routeParams.description: Browser leg: async routeParams(ctx) answers the route parameter values only a run knows, {name: value} or {"/path/:name": {name: value}}, merged over route-params.json.

openSettings.description: Opens the settings pages that would render the module UI.

prepareLoadedOff.description: Persists the operator's statistics toggle off and leaves the connection module unconnected.

triggerAll.description: Exercises every trigger of the outbound-call table the product supports (every_trigger mode).

env.description: Extra environment per mode, without the product prefix (it is added by the harness).
